svg.text: RX V2-2 top — where the 470-1000 uF bulk cap goes (+5V rail)
JP10 (3-pin selector): the OUTER pin your 5V jumper bridges = +5V -- CAP +
JP9 (4-pin GPS header): GD pin, where the GPS black wire is -- CAP -
alternative pair: C2/C5 pads = +5V and GND directly
C5 1uF = the ONLY bulk on +5V today (with C2 100n)
D8 LM66100 ideal diode: ESC/BEC 5V in -> +5V
Path: ESC/BEC 5V (JP1 pin 2) -> D6 -> D8 -> +5V -> IC2 -> 3.3V. USB VBUS -> D5 (1N4148, ~150 mA) -> same +5V.
Cap: 470-1000 uF, 16 V, low ESR, electrolytic - MIND POLARITY. Short leads, glue it down before potting.
